Background

Born in 1977 in Cameroon, Lamyne M lives and works in Saint-Denis. For more than ten years, he has made textile a medium of engagement.

Colonisation, male domination, modern slavery, migration and environmental issues — a hybrid path between Africa, Europe, Asia and Latin America; a work entered the collections of the Harn Museum (Florida) in 2021.

02
